# Pulumi ComponentResource: Web App Infrastructure

## Structure

```
infra/
├── Pulumi.yaml
├── components/
│   └── web_app.py
├── __main__.py
├── dev.yaml
└── prod.yaml
```

## `Pulumi.yaml`

```yaml
name: web-app
runtime: python
description: Stateless web app with S3, RDS, IAM
```

## `components/web_app.py`

```python
import pulumi
import pulumi_aws as aws


class WebAppArgs:
    def __init__(
        self,
        environment: str,                       # "dev" | "prod"
        region: str,
        bucket_replication_region: str = None,  # prod only
        db_instance_class: str = "db.t3.micro",
        db_multi_az: bool = False,
        db_allocated_storage: int = 20,
        oidc_provider_arn: str = None,          # prod: OIDC trust; dev: IAM user
    ):
        self.environment = environment
        self.region = region
        self.bucket_replication_region = bucket_replication_region
        self.db_instance_class = db_instance_class
        self.db_multi_az = db_multi_az
        self.db_allocated_storage = db_allocated_storage
        self.oidc_provider_arn = oidc_provider_arn


class WebApp(pulumi.ComponentResource):
    def __init__(self, name: str, args: WebAppArgs, opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions = None):
        super().__init__("webapp:components:WebApp", name, None, opts)

        is_prod = args.environment == "prod"
        tags = {"Environment": args.environment, "ManagedBy": "Pulumi"}

        child_opts = pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self)

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 1. S3 bucket — versioned, encrypted, no public access
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        self.bucket = aws.s3.Bucket(
            f"{name}-assets",
            versioning=aws.s3.BucketVersioningArgs(
                enabled=True,
            ),
            server_side_encryption_configuration=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationArgs(
                rule=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleArgs(
                    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefaultArgs(
                        sse_algorithm="AES256",
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            tags=tags,
            opts=child_opts,
        )

        aws.s3.BucketPublicAccessBlock(
            f"{name}-assets-pab",
            bucket=self.bucket.id,
            block_public_acls=True,
            block_public_policy=True,
            ignore_public_acls=True,
            restrict_public_buckets=True,
            opts=child_opts,
        )

        # Cross-region replication (prod only)
        if args.bucket_replication_region:
            replica = aws.s3.Bucket(
                f"{name}-assets-replica",
                bucket=f"{name}-assets-replica-{args.environment}",
                versioning=aws.s3.BucketVersioningArgs(enabled=True),
                server_side_encryption_configuration=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationArgs(
                    rule=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleArgs(
                        apply_server_side_encryption_by_default=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefaultArgs(
                            sse_algorithm="AES256",
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                tags=tags,
                opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self, provider=aws.Provider(
                    f"{name}-replica-provider", region=args.bucket_replication_region,
                )),
            )
            repl_role = aws.iam.Role(
                f"{name}-s3-repl-role",
                assume_role_policy=aws.iam.get_policy_document(
                    statements=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementArgs(
                        actions=["sts:AssumeRole"],
                        principals=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementPrincipalArgs(
                            type="Service", identifiers=["s3.amazonaws.com"],
                        )],
                    )],
                ).json,
                opts=child_opts,
            )
            aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfiguration(
                f"{name}-assets-repl",
                bucket=self.bucket.id,
                role=repl_role.arn,
                rules=[aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfigurationRuleArgs(
                    status="Enabled",
                    destination=aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfigurationRuleDestinationArgs(
                        bucket=replica.arn,
                    ),
                )],
                opts=child_opts,
            )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. RDS PostgreSQL — deletion protection, backups, private
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        self.db_subnet_group = aws.rds.SubnetGroup(
            f"{name}-db-subnets",
            subnet_ids=[],  # populated from VPC — see note below
            tags=tags,
            opts=child_opts,
        )

        self.db_password = pulumi.Config("webapp").require_secret("db_password")

        self.db = aws.rds.Instance(
            f"{name}-db",
            engine="postgres",
            engine_version="16.3",
            instance_class=args.db_instance_class,
            allocated_storage=args.db_allocated_storage,
            db_name="webapp",
            username="webapp_admin",
            password=self.db_password,
            db_subnet_group_name=self.db_subnet_group.name,
            publicly_accessible=False,
            multi_az=args.db_multi_az,
            deletion_protection=True,
            backup_retention_period=7,
            storage_encrypted=is_prod,
            skip_final_snapshot=False,
            final_snapshot_identifier=f"{name}-db-final",
            tags=tags,
            opts=child_opts,
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. IAM — service account role (least privilege)
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        if args.oidc_provider_arn:  # prod: OIDC federated trust
            trust_policy = pulumi.Output.json_dumps({
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                    "Principal": {"Federated": args.oidc_provider_arn},
                    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {
                        f"{args.oidc_provider_arn.split('/')[-1]}:sub":
                            f"system:serviceaccount:webapp:webapp-sa",
                    }},
                }],
            })
        else:  # dev: service principal trust
            trust_policy = aws.iam.get_policy_document(
                statements=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementArgs(
                    actions=["sts:AssumeRole"],
                    principals=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementPrincipalArgs(
                        type="Service", identifiers=["eks.amazonaws.com"],
                    )],
                )],
            ).json

        self.service_role = aws.iam.Role(
            f"{name}-service-role",
            assume_role_policy=trust_policy,
            tags=tags,
            opts=child_opts,
        )

        aws.iam.RolePolicy(
            f"{name}-service-policy",
            role=self.service_role.name,
            # Least privilege — scoped to this stack's bucket, no wildcards
            policy=self.bucket.arn.apply(lambda bucket_arn: json.dumps({
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [
                    {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
                        "Resource": [f"{bucket_arn}/*"],
                    },
                    {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": ["s3:ListBucket"],
                        "Resource": [bucket_arn],
                    },
                ],
            })),
            opts=child_opts,
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Outputs
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        self.bucket_name = self.bucket.id
        self.db_endpoint = self.db.endpoint
        self.service_role_arn = self.service_role.arn

        # Connection string (secret) for app consumption
        self.db_connection_string = pulumi.Output.secret(
            pulumi.Output.format(
                "postgresql://webapp_admin:{0}@{1}/webapp",
                self.db_password, self.db.endpoint,
            )
        )

        self.register_outputs({
            "bucket_name": self.bucket_name,
            "db_endpoint": self.db_endpoint,
            "service_role_arn": self.service_role_arn,
            "db_connection_string": self.db_connection_string,
        })
```

## `__main__.py`

```python
import pulumi
import pulumi_aws as aws
from components.web_app import WebApp, WebAppArgs

config = pulumi.Config()
environment = pulumi.get_stack()  # "dev" or "prod"

app = WebApp(
    "webapp",
    WebAppArgs(
        environment=environment,
        region=aws.get_region().name,
        # Prod-only sizing/replication
        db_instance_class=config.get("db_instance_class") or "db.t3.micro",
        db_multi_az=config.get_bool("db_multi_az") or False,
        bucket_replication_region=config.get("replica_region"),
        oidc_provider_arn=config.get("oidc_provider_arn"),
    ),
)

pulumi.export("bucket_name", app.bucket_name)
pulumi.export("db_endpoint", app.db_endpoint)
pulumi.export("service_role_arn", app.service_role_arn)
pulumi.export("db_connection_string", app.db_connection_string)
```

## Usage

```bash
pulumi stack init dev
pulumi config set db_password '...' --secret
pulumi up                          # dev

pulumi stack init prod
pulumi config set db_password '...' --secret
pulumi config set db_multi_az true
pulumi up                          # prod — fully isolated state
```

## Acceptance criteria mapping

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Bucket versioning/SSE/private | `versioning`, `server_side_encryption_configuration` (AES256), `BucketPublicAccessBlock` all-true |
| RDS protection | `deletion_protection=True`, `backup_retention_period=7`, `publicly_accessible=False`, `storage_encrypted` on prod |
| Secret handling | `ConfigSecret` (`require_secret`), connection string wrapped in `Output.secret` — never plaintext in Git |
| IAM least privilege | Bucket-scoped policy only; OIDC-federated trust with `sub` condition on prod; no wildcards |
| Env isolation | Separate stack files → separate Pulumi state; prod changes can't touch dev |

**Note:** VPC/subnets (needed for `db_subnet_group` and the EKS cluster) are omitted per the task's focus on the three wrapped resources — wire `subnet_ids` from your VPC output or `aws.ec2.get_subnet_ids`.
